name: Configure and troubleshoot network connectivity and services
description: Users asked for instructions on configuring, troubleshooting, and managing network connections, interfaces, and services across various operating systems and virtualized environments. The requests covered a wide range of activities, including setting up VPNs and proxies, configuring firewalls and routing, troubleshooting hardware and virtual machine networking, and managing IP addresses or connectivity tools like SSH and NFS.
